name: check_cached_entry_record
description: Makes indirect calls to fetch an entry, then checks three stored values against it and returns zero on a match or minus one otherwise. The listing matches the neighbouring entries, so it is probably a shared body.

name: check_cached_entry_record
description: Makes indirect calls to fetch an entry, then checks three stored values against it and returns zero on a match or minus one otherwise. The listing matches the neighbouring entries, so it is probably a shared body.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:INSTALL:0:1018
name: check_cached_entry_record
description: The recorded size is a single instruction, yet the listing shows the same comparison body as the neighbouring entries, so this is probably a shared listing rather than code unique to this address.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:INSTALL:0:1024
name: verify_game_disk_volume
description: Locks and examines a directory path on the drive labelled df0 and the volume darkseed_1 to confirm the game disk is present, then releases the lock. The listing shown is a shared comparison body, so the volume check rests on the library calls and text evidence.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0000
name: boot_cli_or_workbench_start
description: Program entry point: finds the running task, branches on whether a CLI process is attached, and runs either the workbench message-wait path or the CLI path. It then writes split high and low words from a source table into display slots and calls several unnamed routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0040
name: open_system_libraries
description: Opens the dos, graphics and intuition libraries in turn through the exec open call, and closes any already opened if a later one fails. It returns zero when an open fails.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:00A6
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains no operations and only returns; it is called by three other routines, so it works as a no-op hook.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:00C6
name: install_copper_interrupt_server
description: Writes a text string through dos and manages an interrupt server, enabling DMA through the DMA control register and pointing the copper list at its start. On shutdown it removes the interrupt server, frees memory and closes the library.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0362
name: find_command_table_entry
description: Scans a table of 16-byte entries for one whose first two bytes match the two character codes passed in, stopping at a terminator entry. On a match it sets a flag bit in a control block, runs follow-up calls when the matched code is J, and sets a global flag.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:036A
name: set_control_flags_on_match
description: Sets bit zero of the status byte in a control block, optionally calls a follow-up when the stored character is J, and records a global done flag.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:03C4
name: set_three_control_bytes
description: Makes a series of unnamed routine calls, then writes one byte value into three fields of the control block referenced by the pointer register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0824
name: select_copper_list_for_frame
description: Alternates between two copper list buffers on each call by toggling a flag. It offsets the selected pointer when the video position register reports the long-frame bit, so the display list follows the video field.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0870
name: wrap_call_and_return_input
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns the same 32-bit value that was in the data register on entry, so it is a thin wrapper that passes values through.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:087C
name: tick_frame_and_dispatch_key
description: Advances a small frame counter and a timer, then reads the current key code. When the timer passes its threshold it branches on a stored progress value, either saving two words or passing the key on to further handlers.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0A9C
name: propagate_status_flag_bit
description: Copies the bit-zero status flag from one control block into another, setting that bit on the second block when it is set on the first.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0ADC
name: toggle_indexed_status_flag
description: Flips bit four of a byte in a table selected by the index argument. When a stored mode equals ten it also flips bit zero of a linked block's status byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0B84
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains no operations and only returns, so it has no effect when called.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0BBE
name: split_hours_from_time_count
description: Returns zero for counts below a fixed threshold. Above it, the value is split by 3600 into an hour count, offset by eighteen in the high word, and a remainder in the low word.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0C44
name: lookup_scaled_table_byte
description: Adds a byte to a table value, multiplies the sum by nine, and returns the byte found at that offset in a second data table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0C78
name: copy_record_into_globals
description: Copies the first two words and two single bytes from a source record into fixed global variables, then sets a global mode value to one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0CC2
name: set_object_attribute_bits
description: ORs fixed bit masks into a 16-bit attribute word and an indexed attribute entry. Once the tick counter passes a threshold, it calls up to four unnamed routines depending on a stored code byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0CC8
name: set_indexed_attribute_bits
description: ORs a fixed mask into an indexed attribute entry. Once the tick counter passes a threshold, it calls up to four unnamed routines depending on a stored code byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0CCE
name: run_timed_code_actions
description: Once the tick counter passes a threshold, reads a stored code byte and calls one to three unnamed routines when it equals the '@' or vertical-tab codes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0D02
name: clear_control_status_bit
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then clears bit zero of the status byte in the control block referenced by the pointer register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0D12
name: set_control_status_bit
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then sets bit zero of the status byte in the control block referenced by the pointer register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0D22
name: toggle_control_status_bit
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then flips bit zero of the status byte in the control block referenced by the pointer register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0D3E
name: update_actor_state_machine
description: Reads two position fields and the actor status byte. It clears bit zero when a flag is zero, and otherwise steps through a set of status bits, calling up to eight unnamed routines as it advances the state.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:0FD6
name: stub_empty_return_body
description: The decompiled body is only a return, although the entry records about seventy-eight instructions, so the real logic is not visible here. It calls four unnamed routines and is called by three.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:10C4
name: store_position_and_offset
description: Stores its two 16-bit arguments into fields of a record, then writes a third field computed from fixed base values minus a step scaled by a sixth of an offset derived from the second argument.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1164
name: store_remaining_value_in_fields
description: Clears the high bit of a status byte. When a counter exceeds four, it sets the high bit and subtracts four from the counter, then writes the counter plus a fixed offset into three fields of the record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1190
name: walk_toward_target_checking_bitmap
description: Steps a pair of coordinates toward a target pair by per-axis step sizes, looping until it reaches the target or hits a set bit in a bitmap table, which serves as a collision test.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:120E
name: scan_proximity_list_for_hit
description: Clears a flag on a record, copies two position fields into working fields, then loops over a list of entries comparing absolute coordinate differences with the current position, using a sentinel to end the list.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1306
name: set_step_sizes_and_walk
description: Takes the absolute x and y differences between two points, sets per-axis step sizes from them, then walks toward the target using the same bitmap check as the path routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1352
name: halve_steps_at_low_value
description: Sets a flag in the argument record. When a 16-bit field is below a threshold it calls a unnamed routine, and if a second field is below a lower threshold it halves two step-size bytes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:136A
name: halve_step_sizes
description: Right-shifts the two step-size bytes by one, halving each, and returns the first argument unchanged.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1384
name: search_free_grid_cell
description: When a global flag is clear, searches outward in steps over a bitmap grid for a cell with no bit set and returns that coordinate pair. Otherwise it returns its inputs unchanged.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1430
name: remove_entry_and_reset_state
description: Marks each list entry whose first byte matches the argument as removed. It then calls unnamed routines, shifts a field in one record, copies a 16-bit field between two records, clears bit zero of a status byte and resets two globals.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1458
name: restore_removed_list_entry
description: Restores list entries previously marked as removed by writing the argument byte back into them. It calls two unnamed routines when any entry was restored.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1486
name: reset_record_flags_and_layout
description: Clears bit four across a table of eight-byte records, then picks one of three pairs of 16-bit values from a global selector and stores them into the current record along with a fixed pair of bytes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1522
name: set_record_flag_bits
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then ORs a fixed bit mask into a byte at offset thirteen of the record referenced by the pointer register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1546
name: set_state_after_key_input
description: Calls eight unnamed routines, sets a state byte to four when the key code is newline, and sets a status bit. When the global flag is minus two it sets another bit, then loads a timer and two position words and sets the mode to two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:15BA
name: lookup_table_word_offset
description: Looks up a byte in a global table at an index formed from the argument plus a fixed offset, doubles it, and returns it added to the 16-bit input value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:15D8
name: dispatch_object_by_code
description: Branches on a stored code byte through a series of cases. Each case runs a set of unnamed routine calls and sets a few fields, such as a position value of 800, before returning a result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:1B16
name: toggle_entry_state_flag
description: Flips bit zero of the byte at the pointer argument and passes the pointer to a unnamed routine. The body is large, but most of it is unnamed routine calls that are not visible in this listing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:2098
name: set_three_frame_indices
description: Calls unnamed routines and writes three small index values, 29, 30 and 29, into the field at offset 54 of three records in turn.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:20BC
name: halt_forever_loop
description: Calls three unnamed routines and then loops forever, so it never returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:20CC
name: toggle_status_bit_after_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then flips bit zero of a status byte in a linked control block.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:20DE
name: wait_until_value_clears
description: Clears a global value and then spins in a loop until the 16-bit argument becomes zero, which makes it a busy-wait.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:2106
name: reset_state_and_fill_fields
description: When a mode byte is neither zero nor four, clears it and clears bit zero of a status byte, then calls unnamed routines. It clears bit seven of another status byte and sets three fields to a fixed value of 28.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:213E
name: show_end_screen_and_halt
description: Sets bit zero of a status byte, calls unnamed routines that show the text THE END, then loops forever and never returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:2230
name: copy_table_and_set_defaults
description: When a code byte is below thirty-two, calls unnamed routines and sets four global values to 70, 34, 46 and 18. It then copies five 32-bit entries from one table to another, after conditionally calling unnamed routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:2282
name: halt_after_helper_calls
description: Calls two unnamed routines and then loops forever, so it never returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:232C
name: initialise_object_from_source
description: Copies two position fields from a source record into the target, sets the target's status and timer fields, then alternates a state byte between zero and one around a short sequence of unnamed routine calls.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:239A
name: start_position_copy_sequence
description: Sets a global flag to one, calls unnamed routines, then runs the position copy: a field is shifted in one record, a 16-bit position is copied into two other records, bit zero of a status byte is cleared and two globals are reset.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:23C4
name: copy_position_to_records
description: Shifts a field in one record, copies a 16-bit position field into two other records, clears bit zero of a status byte, and resets two globals to zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:23FA
name: find_record_with_key_byte
description: Scans a table of three-byte records, stopping at a terminator, and returns early when a record's second byte equals the argument byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:2418
name: append_entry_and_count
description: Calls a unnamed routine and marks a record field with the removed marker. It stores the argument byte at the current position of a list, bumps the count, and derives a second global from the count when it reaches eight or more.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:2446
name: remove_byte_from_list
description: Calls a unnamed routine and clears a field in a record. It searches a byte list for the argument and, when found, shifts the later bytes down over it and decrements the list count.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:248C
name: copy_position_to_records
description: Shifts a field in one record, copies a 16-bit position field into two other records, clears bit zero of a status byte, and resets two globals to zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:2494
name: clear_flag_and_status_bit
description: Clears bit four of a global flag byte and bit zero of a status byte in a linked record, then calls one unnamed routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:24B0
name: set_handler_flag_and_labels
description: Sets a handler flag to one and clears bit zero of a status byte and a byte at offset thirteen. It then calls unnamed routines and writes the letters A and B into the byte at offset three of two records.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:24B4
name: set_handler_flag_and_labels
description: Sets a handler flag to one and clears bit zero of a status byte and a byte at offset thirteen. It then calls unnamed routines and writes the letters A and B into the byte at offset three of two records.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:2508
name: allocate_block_with_status_codes
description: Sets a handler mode, calls unnamed routines, and allocates a memory block through a library call. It returns small status codes of one, two or three for the failure cases, and zero otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:2528
name: program_blitter_registers
description: Toggles a global flag and calls unnamed routines, then writes mask and control values into the blitter's custom chip registers, using the two arguments to set the transfer parameters.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:2554
name: initialise_entry_table
description: Calls many unnamed routines, then fills a list of 24-byte entries in a loop. Each entry gets two 16-bit fields set to 10 and 160 and a byte set to four, until a unnamed routine reports no more entries, after which further unnamed routines are called.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:26E6
name: copy_table_and_run_setup
description: Stores a code word in a global, calls unnamed routines, and when the code equals nineteen calls four more unnamed routines. It then copies five 32-bit entries between tables and performs further setup depending on the code.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:28C2
name: free_blocks_in_range
description: Calls the exec FreeMem routine repeatedly, counting a register down from its starting value to minus one and freeing one block on each pass.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:28E2

description: Calls unnamed routines and, when a source byte is above 119, stores a 32-bit value into a table at an index derived from it. When a bit flag is set it searches a table with six-byte entries for the byte value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5AB4
name: set_pointer_after_helpers
description: Calls six unnamed routines and then sets a pointer global to a fixed address.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5B2C
name: call_fifteen_helpers
description: Calls fifteen unnamed routine routines in sequence and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5C0C
name: find_table_entry_and_count
description: Clears one byte of a buffer at an offset, increments a counter byte in a record, then searches a table of entries for the one matching the argument. When it finds one it records the entry and returns a value derived from it.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5C10
name: find_table_entry_and_count
description: Alternate version of its neighbour: it increments a counter byte in a record, then searches the table for the argument's entry and processes the match.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5C1C
name: find_table_entry_and_process
description: Searches a table for the entry matching the argument. Depending on a flag byte in that entry, it calls unnamed routines to process it and returns a value derived from it.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5C76
name: copy_sixteen_words_to_buffer
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from the source into a buffer starting at offset thirty-six.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5C84
name: invert_two_bytes
description: Stores the bitwise complement of each of two source bytes into the destination.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5C94
name: render_status_text_lines
description: Returns early when a global is set. Otherwise it makes a series of unnamed routine calls that render text lines with page, paragraph, line and word labels, and stores 13 in a global.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5D40
name: stub_unreached_gap_code
description: An unreached gap that decodes as code: it increments a counter, may loop forever, and calls a few unnamed routines, so its purpose cannot be determined from this listing alone.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5D82
name: fill_text_buffer_with_spaces
description: Fills three 32-bit words of a text buffer with spaces, places a left-angle character before them, then loops over the text rendering unnamed routines.

name: store_value_and_call_helper
description: Stores a 16-bit register value into a global and calls one unnamed routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5F14
name: load_sixteen_words_from_table
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then copies sixteen 16-bit words from a table just before the argument address into the global area.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5F34
name: load_sixteen_words_from_table
description: Same body as its neighbour: copies sixteen 16-bit words from a table into the global area after two unnamed routine calls.

name: load_sixteen_words_from_table
description: Same body as its neighbours: copies sixteen 16-bit words from a table into the global area after unnamed routine calls.

name: subtract_nibbles_against_value
description: Processes the low nibbles of each byte in a table against the argument value, storing a difference where the table nibble is larger, and writes the packed results back.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5F86
name: copy_sixteen_words_out
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then copies sixteen 16-bit words from the global area into a destination table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5FA2
name: load_sixteen_words_from_arg
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from the table at the address passed in the pointer register, starting 32 bytes before it, into the global area.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5FBA
name: combine_nibble_tables
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then loops over two 16-byte tables, comparing the low nibbles of corresponding bytes and writing a combined nibble result to the output.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5FC0
name: merge_nibble_rows
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then for each of sixteen rows compares the low nibbles from two source tables and writes a merged nibble value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:5FC4
name: merge_nibble_rows
description: Same nibble-merging loop as its neighbour, with unnamed routine calls for the write-back.

name: map_key_to_direction_step
description: Tests the current key code against a set of letter codes. The a and c keys move the 16-bit argument down or up by one step, and other keys are handled in later branches.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6162
name: stub_empty_return
description: Reassigns a global to itself and returns, so it has no effect. It is called by one routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:61E0
name: poll_input_and_video_state
description: Entry for a reference run that sets a copper list pointer, reads the joystick and mouse movement data, the fire-button and potentiometer registers, and the video position register. It selects a display list and calls unnamed routines.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Only returns, with no body. It is called by two routines and is also reached from outside the static flow.

description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from the source address into the global area, one word at a time.

name: copy_sixteen_words_from_source
description: Same as its neighbours: copies sixteen 16-bit words from the source address into the global area.

name: copy_string_until_nul
description: Copies bytes one at a time from a source through a library call into a destination, stopping at a zero byte or when a count runs out. It then calls unnamed routines and returns a combined value.

name: clear_bytes_until_zero
description: Zeroes bytes in a buffer one at a time, calling a unnamed routine on each pass, until the count runs out or a byte that is already zero is found.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Only returns, with no body. It is called by two routines.

name: set_count_field_to_one
description: Sets a 16-bit field at offset eighteen of the record to one, reassigns a global to itself, and returns.

name: clear_two_blocks_of_longwords
description: For each of two records, zeroes seven groups of four 32-bit values, starting at offset 170.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:68E2
name: setup_and_halt_loop
description: Sets a pointer global, zeroes a couple of globals, calls unnamed routines, and then loops forever, so it never returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6984

description: For each of two records, copies seven rows of sixteen bytes from a source area at offset 664 into the record at offset 171.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6A00
name: set_mask_word_after_helper
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then sets a 32-bit mask global to a fixed bit pattern.

name: set_mask_word_after_helper
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then sets a 32-bit mask global to a fixed bit pattern.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6A28
name: set_mask_clear_bit_zero
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then sets a 32-bit mask global to all bits set except bit zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6A38
name: copy_blocks_into_two_records
description: For each of two records, copies seven rows of 18 bytes from a source area into the record at offset 171, advancing through the source.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6A76
name: dispatch_on_mode_code
description: Compares a mode byte with the argument and with the codes zero, one and five, calling unnamed routines for each case. For the code one case it also sets a result to one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6AA8
name: repeat_helper_until_flag
description: Repeats a unnamed routine call with the current arguments, stopping when a global flag is set or a unnamed routine reports zero. It calls one more unnamed routine afterwards.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6AE0
name: copy_record_fields_if_empty
description: When the second longword of the target is zero, copies a 16-bit field and a byte from the source record into the target and calls one unnamed routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6AFE
name: run_wait_loop_then_halt
description: Calls unnamed routines and, if a state value is zero, calls more unnamed routines and then loops forever. Otherwise it runs a wait-and-step loop until the state is cleared.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6B0E
name: run_wait_loop_until_clear
description: Runs a wait-and-step loop on a state value between unnamed routine calls. If the state is zero at the start, it halts in an infinite loop.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6B20
name: run_wait_loop_then_mark
description: Runs a wait-and-step loop on a state value between unnamed routine calls until the result is zero, then sets two globals to 48 and 1 and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6B7C
name: lookup_and_store_state_byte
description: Computes a table index from the argument with its low bits set, reads a byte at that index and stores it as a state value. When the state is non-zero it may return early, otherwise it calls unnamed routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6B80
name: lookup_and_store_state_byte
description: Same table-indexed state update as its neighbours, from a different entry point.

name: lookup_and_store_state_byte
description: Same table-indexed state update as its neighbours, from a different entry point.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6B88
name: lookup_and_store_state_byte
description: Same table-indexed state update as its neighbours, storing the computed value into a fixed cell.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6BA4
name: read_file_block_into_buffer
description: Looks up a state byte from a table at an index derived from the argument. When a flag is set and a buffer is active it reads data from a file through the dos library into an allocated buffer, refers to the text R00A, and returns its input pair.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6C98
name: free_buffer_if_allocated
description: Clears a status pointer and, if a buffer was allocated, frees it through the exec library and clears its stored pointer. It then returns its input.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6CC2
name: store_result_when_buffer_active
description: When a flag is set and a buffer pointer is active, stores the result of a unnamed routine into a global, then sets a state value to sixteen and then to one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6D00
name: repeat_until_helper_zero
description: Calls a unnamed routine repeatedly until it returns zero, then sets a global to 48 and then to one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6D20
name: free_buffer_and_return_value
description: Calls unnamed routines, clears a pointer flag, and frees the buffer through the library if one is still allocated. It then returns the unnamed routine's result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6D36
name: free_buffer_and_return_value
description: Same as its neighbour with fewer unnamed routine calls: it frees an allocated buffer through the library and returns the unnamed routine's result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6D54
name: call_helper_when_flag_set
description: Calls one unnamed routine when a global flag is non-zero, and returns its input pair unchanged.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6D5C
name: call_helper_when_flag_set
description: Calls one unnamed routine when a global flag is non-zero, and returns its input pair unchanged.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6DA0
name: mask_out_two_status_bits
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then returns the 16-bit argument with bits six and seven of its low byte cleared.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:0:6DAE
name: call_two_helpers_and_return
description: Calls two unnamed routines and returns, with no data of its own.
